title: Lecture 2 — Foundations
description: Foundational questions on HTML, document structure, elements, lists, links, and validation.
subject: Web Development

questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML is the standard markup language used to structure web documents.

questions.question: Which organization sets the standards for HTML and its related languages?
questions.explanation: The World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) develops Web standards, including HTML recommendations.

questions.question: What is the correct Document Type Definition (DTD) for HTML5?
questions.explanation: The HTML5 doctype is the short declaration <!DOCTYPE html>.

questions.question: The purpose of the <head> section in an HTML document is to:
options: Contain the main text and images that display in the browser window.
Provide the primary heading for the page.
Contain descriptive information about the web page document that does not display directly on the page.
questions.correctAnswer: Contain descriptive information about the web page document that does not display directly on the page.
questions.explanation: The head contains metadata and other document information rather than the page's displayed content.

questions.question: Which element configures the text that will appear in the title bar or tab of the browser window?
questions.explanation: The title element sets the document title shown in the browser tab.

questions.question: The <meta charset="utf-8"> tag is an example of a:
options: Container tag with an opening and closing tag.
questions.explanation: A meta element is a void element and does not have a closing tag.

questions.question: How many levels of heading elements are available in HTML?
questions.explanation: HTML provides six heading levels, from h1 through h6.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about block display elements like headings and paragraphs?
options: They display right in line with the surrounding text.
They do not require a closing tag.
They are only used inside the <head> section.
They are rendered by the browser with empty space above and below them.
questions.correctAnswer: They are rendered by the browser with empty space above and below them.
questions.explanation: Block elements begin on a new line and commonly have spacing above and below.

questions.question:
What is the purpose of the
element?
options: To draw a horizontal line across the page.
To cause the next element or text to display on a new line.
To break a long webpage into multiple separate files.
questions.correctAnswer: To cause the next element or text to display on a new line.
questions.explanation: The br void element creates a line break.

questions.question: Which tag indents a block of text for special emphasis?
questions.explanation: The blockquote element represents a block quotation and is conventionally indented by browsers.

questions.question: Unlike block elements, phrase elements like <b>, <i>, and <em> are displayed:
options: Right in line with the text (inline display).
With empty space above and below.
questions.correctAnswer: Right in line with the text (inline display).
questions.explanation: Phrase elements are inline and flow with surrounding text.

questions.question: Which HTML element is used to create an ordered list?
questions.explanation: The ol element creates an ordered list; li elements represent its items.

questions.question: In a description list, what does the <dt> tag contain?
questions.explanation: The dt element identifies the term; dd contains its description.

questions.question: Which entity code is used to display a copyright symbol on a web page?
questions.explanation: The © character reference displays the copyright symbol.

questions.question: What is the <nav> element primarily used for?
options: Containing the web page document's main navigation links.
questions.correctAnswer: Containing the web page document's main navigation links.
questions.explanation: The nav semantic element groups major navigation links.

questions.question: Which structural element configures a generic block area or division on a web page?
questions.explanation: The div element is a generic block container for grouping content.

questions.question: What attribute within the anchor <a> tag specifies the destination file name or URL?
questions.explanation: The href attribute specifies the hyperlink destination.

questions.question: What is a site map?
options: A map embedded from Google Maps.
A visual representation of the structure or organization of pages in a website.
A special XML file used only by web servers.
The physical location of the web server on a map.
questions.correctAnswer: A visual representation of the structure or organization of pages in a website.
questions.explanation: A site map represents the organization and relationships of pages in a website.

questions.question: How are comments written in HTML?
questions.explanation: HTML comments begin with <!-- and end with -->.

questions.question: Why should web developers use the W3C HTML Validation Tool?
options: To check code for syntax errors and ensure more consistent browser display.
To convert HTML files into PDF documents.
questions.correctAnswer: To check code for syntax errors and ensure more consistent browser display.
questions.explanation: Validation helps find markup errors and supports more consistent rendering.
